Error domain
identifiers where the top 32 bits (i.e. bit #63..#32) are equal to 0xc000'0000 are re-
served for vendor-specific error domains. Bits #31..#16 hold the vendor's numerical
identifier, and bits #15..#0 can be used by each vendor for error domain identifiers.
